connector.name: Custom Blinds Shop
connector.registryDescription: South Africa's first AI-transactable blinds, shutters and awnings catalogue with live ZAR pricing.
connector.summary: Hosted at shop.customblinds.co.za over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the customblinds account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token — only for submit_enquiry and create_order. Catalogue and pricing tools are open.
